candidates.story: Busy commuter corridor off the highway. Looks best on paper.

verbatims: There are already five burger places on that exit. I have my spot.

candidates.name: Maple Crossing
candidates.story: Growing suburb, young families, one ageing burger option.

verbatims: Nothing open near here after the school run. We drive 15 minutes.
I would love a proper breakfast that runs late, we never make it before 10:30.

candidates.name: Harbor South
candidates.story: Dense, younger, late-night crowd near a college. Lower incomes.

verbatims: Price matters most. Under $10 or I go elsewhere.

questions.text: How often do you buy from a burger restaurant or drive-thru?
Where do you usually go for a quick burger now?
Which of these would make you most and least likely to visit a new burger restaurant near you?
At what price would a burger meal be too cheap / a bargain / getting expensive / too expensive?
If a new burger restaurant opened within 5 minutes of you with your top pick, how likely are you to visit in the first month?
What's missing from burger options near you?
